deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Footer background, primary text on light surfaces, heading color, dark card surfaces — the near-black violet that carries Navan's brand weight across all dark regions and high-emphasis text

vivid-iris.$description: Vivid Iris — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

iris-mist.$description: Iris Mist — Soft highlight wash, light accent surface, decorative tag fill — the barely-there violet tint that signals brand presence on neutral cards

iris-glow.$description: Iris Glow — Mid-stop in atmospheric brand gradients — bridges deep iris and rose highlights in hero washes; Horizontal brand gradient wash — violet to rose light streak used as a decorative band

cinder.$description: Cinder — Primary text, icon strokes, dark UI text — the body and heading ink

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted body text, secondary borders, supporting icon strokes

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text, caption labels, inactive placeholders

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary text, metadata, low-emphasis labels

mist-border.$description: Mist Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, input borders — the universal separator

canvas-tint.$description: Canvas Tint — Page background, nav background, surface wash — the cool off-white that sets the overall canvas

surface-white.$description: Surface White — Elevated card surface, subtle panel background — sits one step above canvas

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, button text, inverted text on dark fills, badge text

jet.$description: Jet — High-contrast text, icon fills, logo wordmark

violet-twilight.$description: Violet Twilight — Deep gradient origin for atmospheric hero washes — the darkest stop in radial brand gradients

neue-hass-grotesk-text.$description: Body, nav, buttons, badges, cards — the workhorse grotesque that carries 90% of the interface. Weights stay light-to-medium (300–500), never bold, keeping the voice conversational rather than corporate

neue-haas-grotesk-display-pro.$description: Display, nav emphasis, large UI — the 135px weight-300 headline size is the signature: an anti-convention whisper-weight display that signals premium restraint. 0.04em positive tracking on display sizes gives airy breathing room

sanomat.$description: Editorial headlines and section titles — a serif/display face that introduces warmth and a magazine-cover quality. Used at 30–45px with tight 1.0–1.2 leading, it contrasts the grotesque body and signals premium content

neue-hass-grotesk-display.$description: Neue Hass Grotesk Display — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

karla.$description: Karla — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
